message.reasoning_content:
I'll use LC_ALL=C to get deterministic byte-order, case-sensitive sorting: Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum. That matches "区分大小写" dictionary order most naturally (uppercase A < lowercase a).

Write final words file and notes.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "LC_ALL=C sort -u <(tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' < data/b.txt | sed '/^$/d') > out/words.txt
SUM=$(awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}' data/a.txt)
N=$(wc -l < out/words.txt)
printf '%s\n' "$SUM" > out/sum.txt
printf '%s\n' "两数结果：整数和为 $SUM，去重单词共 $N 个。" > out/notes.txt
echo "=== out/sum.txt ==="; cat out/sum.txt
echo "=== out/words.txt ==="; cat out/words.txt
echo "=== out/notes.txt ==="; cat out/notes.txt
echo "=== sha256 ==="; sha256sum out/sum.txt out/words.txt out/notes.txt"}
